retainedReference.title: Mosque of the Agas, Topkapi Palace

pictures.author: Amaury Laporte
pictures.observed: Close courtyard corner: pale rough stone with thin brick courses, two window rows, pointed red-brick upper heads/pale grids, lower round pale surrounds/screened backs and brick pointed relieving arches. Small low independent range at the left retained.

pictures.author: Amaury Laporte
pictures.observed: Whole courtyard elevation: long rectangular striped hall, six working upper bays partly hidden by cypresses, round lower windows, small entrance hood, shallow curved lead barrel roof with transverse bands and a small visible finial. Background Tower of Justice and low attached range are independent.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Mosque of the Agas/Ağalar Camii main hall on way32396236: striped pale stone and narrow red-brick courses, tall pointed upper windows/pale grilles, round lower screened windows with pale surrounds/pointed brick relieving arches, an open front entrance with small lead hood/steps, and a shallow lead barrel roof with hipped ends/transverse bands and a representative finial. Preserve the independent low attached range and other palace members. No invented minaret/dome, copied inscriptions, historic manuscripts, plants or furnished prayer/library interior.
